senses.zh_definition: 鹰类猛禽，通常捕食小型鸟兽。
senses.en_definition: A bird of prey that hunts smaller birds and animals.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, sejenis burung pemangsa; padanan umum bahasa Melayu ialah burung helang.
senses.nuances: hawk 是英语词头，不能据此认定为规范马来语词。helang 是通用对应词；精确鸟种名称须另行核定。以下搭配使用马来语对应表达。[DBP 英马对应](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=lang)。

senses.zh_definition: 鹰派人物；主张军事行动或强硬政策的人。
senses.en_definition: A person who advocates military action or a forceful policy.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, orang yang menyokong tindakan ketenteraan atau dasar yang tegas dan keras.
senses.nuances: 政治比喻义，常与 dove 对举；经济报道中也可指主张严控通胀的人。马来语应按语境说明其具体政策立场。[英语政治及经济义项](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hawk)。

collocations.zh: 主张军事行动的鹰派人物
主张强硬抗通胀政策的人

senses.zh_definition: 沿街叫卖或兜售；也可指四处推销产品或主张。
senses.en_definition: To peddle goods or persistently offer something for sale or acceptance.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, menjaja barang atau menawarkan sesuatu kepada orang ramai secara berulang-ulang.
senses.nuances: 马来语用 menjaja、berjaja 或按语境用 mempromosikan。推销观点的比喻用法可能带贬义；此义与鸟义不是同一词源。[DBP 叫卖义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=menyebarkan)、[英语扩展用法](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hawk)。

senses.zh_definition: 用力清嗓，将痰从喉咙深处咳出。
senses.en_definition: To clear the throat forcefully or bring up phlegm.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, mengeluarkan bunyi kerongkong yang kasar untuk menaikkan atau mengeluarkan kahak.
senses.nuances: 常见结构 hawk up phlegm；不同于轻轻 berdehem，也不等同于任何一种吐口水动作。[英语义项](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hawk)。

senses.zh_definition: 使用训练过的鹰狩猎；亦指像鹰一样在飞行中捕食。
senses.en_definition: To hunt with a trained hawk or catch prey in flight.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, berburu dengan helang terlatih atau menangkap mangsa ketika terbang.
senses.nuances: 专门的狩猎或自然观察用语；马来语通常采用说明性表达。[英语义项](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hawk)。

senses.zh_definition: 泥工托灰板；底部有把手、用于承托砂浆或抹灰材料的小板。
senses.en_definition: A small board with an underside handle for holding plaster or mortar.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris pertukangan, papan kecil bertangkai di bawahnya untuk menampung bahan lepa atau mortar.
senses.nuances: 建筑专业义，与鸟类无关。这里使用马来语说明性译法，不冒充已核定的 DBP 专业术语。[英语义项](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hawk)。

etymology.historical_story: English hawk for the bird descends from Old English hafoc. Its modern political use evokes an aggressive bird, contrasting with the peaceful dove. The selling verb has a different history: it was formed from hawker. These overlapping spellings explain why Malay translation must follow context, using helang, a policy description, or menjaja. [Word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hawk), [political meaning](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hawk).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先想天空里的 hawk＝helang；看到商品就转到 menjaja，看到战争或政策就想到主张强硬行动的人。

senses.zh_definition: 人或物消失、失踪或不再存在这一事件；具体指谁或什么消失，由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: The disappearance, loss, or absence of someone or something identified by context.
senses.ms_definition: Hal seseorang atau sesuatu tidak kelihatan, tidak dapat ditemukan atau tidak ada lagi.
senses.nuances: 这是 hilang 加 -nya 构成的语法形式，并非另一个独立词根。例如 hilangnya seorang pendaki 指“一名登山者失踪”。名词化功能参见 [DBP 关于 -nya 的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penekan)。本条马来语释义为依据词根义和语法功能编写的综合释义，并非 DBP 对完整词形的逐字定义。

etymology.historical_story: Hilangnya is best understood through Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowing story. Its base, hilang, describes disappearance or loss. Adding -nya allows a speaker to present that event as something to discuss: a disappearance, its cause, or its consequences. The same grammatical resource connects everyday reports of missing belongings with formal discussions of lost public trust.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 hilang＝“不见了”，再把 -nya 想成给事件贴上标签：hilangnya kunci＝“钥匙不见这件事”。这是语法记忆法，不是词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: As an English given name, Haley is recorded as a variant of Hayley, with connections to surname usage. This explains a possible appearance in Malay text: a writer may simply be referring to a person. It does not establish a Malay lexical meaning, and the isolated lowercase token cannot identify its intended bearer. [Name reference: Haley](https://www.behindthename.com/name/haley)

senses.zh_definition: 激素；由内分泌腺等组织产生、作为化学信使调节其他器官或组织活动的物质。
senses.en_definition: A chemical messenger produced by endocrine glands or other tissues that regulates activity in other organs or tissues.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan kimia yang dikeluarkan dalam kelenjar endokrin dan mempunyai kesan terhadap kegiatan organ-organ lain.
senses.nuances: 是中性的生理学术语，涵盖多种激素，不专指性激素，也不等同于类固醇。[释义依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hormon)。

senses.zh_definition: 激素制剂；以激素为有效成分或具有相应激素作用的制剂。
senses.en_definition: A preparation containing a hormone or providing hormonal activity.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan atau sediaan yang dibuat daripada hormon atau digunakan untuk memberikan kesan hormon.
senses.nuances: 此义指使用的制剂，而不是体内自然分泌的物质。是否具有激素作用须依据具体成分，不能仅凭“药物”这一类别判断。

senses.zh_definition: 植物激素；调节植物生长、发育等生理过程的有机信号物质。
senses.en_definition: An organic signalling substance that regulates growth, development, or other processes in plants.
senses.ms_definition: Sebatian organik dalam tumbuh-tumbuhan yang mempengaruhi proses pertumbuhan, perkembangan atau proses fisiologi lain.
senses.nuances: 植物没有动物式的内分泌腺，因此不能把动物激素定义中的腺体条件机械套用到此义。[植物义依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hormon)。

etymology.historical_story: Hormon belongs to the international scientific vocabulary associated with English hormone. Ernest Starling introduced the term in 1905 to describe chemical messengers linking activity in different parts of the body. Its Greek source means to stimulate or set in motion, an apt image for substances that carry signals and trigger physiological responses. [Source: Society for Endocrinology](https://www.endocrinology.org/endocrinologist/141-autumn-2021/features/the-birth-of-endocrinology-and-neuroendocrinology/).

senses.zh_definition: 幻觉：在没有相应真实外界刺激的情况下，产生仿佛看见、听见或触及某物的感知体验。
senses.en_definition: A sensory experience, such as seeing or hearing something, without a corresponding real external stimulus.
senses.ms_definition: Pengalaman seolah-olah dapat melihat, mendengar atau menyentuh sesuatu yang sebenarnya tidak wujud akibat gangguan kesihatan atau pengambilan dadah.
senses.nuances: 指感知体验，不等同于白日梦、想象或妄想；不能仅凭这个词推断具体疾病或原因。义项依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=halusinasi)。

senses.zh_definition: 人工智能幻觉：人工智能系统生成错误、无依据或虚构的信息，却将其呈现为真实可信的内容。
senses.en_definition: False, unsupported or fabricated information generated by an AI system and presented as factual.
senses.ms_definition: Maklumat salah atau rekaan yang dijanakan oleh sistem kecerdasan buatan tetapi dikemukakan seolah-olah benar.
senses.nuances: 属于技术语境中的引申义，不表示机器具有人的感知体验；不能泛指一切软件故障。马来语释义为概括，相关用法见 [DBP《Bahasa dan Teknologi》](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2025/07/02/19066/)。

dual_scenarios.en: The report documents the auditory hallucinations described by the patient.

etymology.historical_story: Halusinasi belongs to an international medical vocabulary whose European relatives trace back to Latin hallucinatio. Malay treats the borrowed form as a complete lexical base and adds ber- to express experiencing hallucinations. Its resemblance to Malay halus is accidental. The precise borrowing route into Malay is not established here. See the [Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9H0104).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 halusinasi 与英语 hallucination 配对记忆：感官仿佛收到信号，外界却没有对应来源；不要拆成 halus。

senses.en_definition: An unresolved proper-name form; one verified referent is a moon of Saturn.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk nama khas yang rujukannya belum dipastikan; salah satu rujukan yang disahkan ialah sebuah satelit semula jadi Zuhal.
senses.nuances: 未核实为具有普通词义的马来语词条，因此不能诚实地标记为 official，也不能提供所谓 DBP 官方释义。NASA 确认 Helene 是土星卫星名称，但将输入词识别为该卫星仍属未证实的推断。以下搭配及例句仅演示这一已核实的天文用法，不代表高频马来语搭配。[NASA：Helene](https://science.nasa.gov/saturn/moons/helene/)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied token has no definition or identifying context, so its own origin remains unresolved. One documented namesake is Saturn's moon Helene, discovered in 1980. NASA explains that the moon was named after the Greek mythological figure associated with the Trojan War. That naming history belongs specifically to the astronomical object and must not be assigned automatically to every occurrence of helene. [NASA: Helene](https://science.nasa.gov/saturn/moons/helene/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 Helene 当作“需要认人的名字”：先确认它指谁或什么，再确定读音和含义；不要从字母硬猜词义。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入作为未加马来语词缀的基础形式处理；英语内部为复合词。/əʊ/ 属于一个音节核，词尾 -stead 读 /sted/。

senses.zh_definition: 一家人居住的住宅及其周围土地、附属建筑，尤指乡间农居；也可指祖传家宅。
senses.en_definition: A family dwelling with its surrounding land and buildings, especially a rural property; also an ancestral home.
senses.ms_definition: Rumah kediaman sesebuah keluarga berserta tanah dan bangunan di sekelilingnya, khususnya di kawasan luar bandar; juga rumah pusaka keluarga.
senses.nuances: 这是英语名词义。马来语可按语境释作 rumah dan tanah sekitarnya 或 rumah pusaka；不能一律译作 ladang。homestead 与 homestay 不同：后者涉及寄宿或住宿安排。本条马来语定义为编辑性释义。[Merriam-Webster：homestead](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/homestead)。

senses.zh_definition: 在美国历史语境中，按宅地制度通过申请、居住及耕作而取得的土地。
senses.en_definition: Land acquired under a homestead system through application, residence, and cultivation, especially in United States history.
senses.ms_definition: Tanah yang diperoleh melalui permohonan, pendudukan dan pengusahaan menurut sistem pemberian tanah homestead, khususnya dalam sejarah Amerika Syarikat.
senses.nuances: 属于特定历史制度用语，不等于一般“免费土地”，也不能直接套用于马来西亚土地制度。1862 年美国《宅地法》是这一用法的重要背景。[美国国家档案馆：Homestead Act](https://www.archives.gov/milestone-documents/homestead-act)。

senses.zh_definition: 在马来西亚部分地产及估价资料中，结合农业土地用途与住宅建设的农居型地块或开发形式。
senses.en_definition: In some Malaysian property terminology, an agricultural residential lot or development combining cultivation and a dwelling.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan hartanah tertentu di Malaysia, lot atau pembangunan yang menggabungkan tanah pertanian dengan kediaman.
senses.nuances: 此用法见 NAPIC 的地产定义手册，属于有本地出处的行业用语；这并不证明它已成为 DBP 的通用马来语词条。具体项目条件应以相关文件为准。[NAPIC：Manual Definisi](https://napic2.jpph.gov.my/storage/app/media/5-warga/dokumen/manual-definisi-napic-mod.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 在土地上定居、耕作并将其建立为家园，尤指按宅地制度取得或占居土地。
senses.en_definition: To acquire, occupy, or settle on land as a homestead.
senses.ms_definition: Memperoleh, menduduki atau mengusahakan tanah untuk dijadikan tempat kediaman dan kehidupan keluarga.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词用法；马来语完整句子通常改用 menetap、meneroka 或 mengusahakan tanah，不宜把英语动词直接当作马来语动词使用。以下搭配是释义性马来语表达。[Merriam-Webster：homestead](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/homestead)。

senses.zh_definition: 通过种植、饲养、储存食物等方式过节俭或自给程度较高的农居生活。
senses.en_definition: To pursue a frugal or largely self-sufficient lifestyle, especially by producing and preserving food.
senses.ms_definition: Menjalani kehidupan berjimat atau berdikari, khususnya dengan menghasilkan dan mengawet makanan sendiri.
senses.nuances: 这是英语中的现代生活方式用法，不必涉及历史上的土地申请制度。马来语宜解释为 menjalani kehidupan sara diri。以下搭配为释义表达。[Merriam-Webster：homestead](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/homestead)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 历史、地产与生活方式语境的含义不同，应明确所指。描述有人长期居住或耕作的土地时，不宜仅因缺少熟悉的建筑形式就称其为“无人土地”。

etymology.historical_story: Homestead continues Old English hamstede, combining the ideas of home and place. Its older domestic meaning later acquired a distinctive American frontier association. The Homestead Act of 1862 offered qualifying applicants a route to land ownership through residence and cultivation, making the word a label for both a family home and a settlement institution. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/homestead); [historical document](https://www.archives.gov/milestone-documents/homestead-act).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作 HOME-sted：home 是家，stead 表示地方，合起来记成“安家的地方”。不要把词尾看成 stay；homestead 不等于 homestay。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 严格说是后附代词，通常指前文的人或事物，不表示时态；ny 读 /ɲ/。数据包的 hidupkan 是直接构词基础，更深层词根为 hidup。

senses.zh_definition: 启动它，使设备运转；打开或点亮它。
senses.en_definition: Start it, switch it on, or light it.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan alat itu berfungsi atau menyebabkan lampu dan api itu menyala.
senses.nuances: 常用于祈使句；-nya 的对象须能从上下文确定。正式主动陈述通常用 menghidupkannya。各义按 menghidupkan 的词义转述，并结合 -nya 解释。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=menghidupkan)

senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan makhluk itu terus bernyawa, tumbuh atau bernyawa kembali.
senses.nuances: 对象为生物；是否表示维持生命或复活，由语境决定。复活义常见于宗教、神话或虚构叙事。

senses.ms_definition: Menggiatkan kembali usaha, pertubuhan atau tradisi itu, atau membangkitkan kenangan tersebut.

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan gambaran itu lebih nyata, suasana lebih meriah, atau minat dan perasaan lebih kuat.
senses.nuances: 艺术表现、社交气氛和心理活动中的比喻用法；不表示真正赋予生命。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 操作说明中适合使用此形式；一般正式陈述应按句法使用 menghidupkannya 或 dihidupkannya。谈论真实死亡或丧亲时，避免轻率使用“使其复活”的说法。

etymology.historical_story: Hidupkannya is a grammatical combination rather than a separate borrowed word. Malay builds a causative verb from hidup, meaning alive, with -kan, then attaches -nya to refer back to an understood object. The same idea of giving life connects starting a machine, reviving an organization, and making a story vivid.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hidup＝活；-kan＝使；-nya＝它：让它“活起来”，机器就是启动，故事就是写活。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为借入的单音节词整体记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。hop-daktur 是相关的历史复合形式，不是加词缀产生的派生词。

word_family.gloss: 主编；历史口语复合形式

senses.zh_definition: 首领；负责人；村长。属于词典标注为荷兰语来源的旧称。
senses.en_definition: A chief, head, or village headman; a historical Dutch-derived term.
senses.ms_definition: Ketua atau lurah; kata berlabel IB dalam Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat.
senses.nuances: DBP 的 IB 表示 bahasa Belanda，即荷兰语来源。该义适合解释旧文献；现代马来西亚通常用 ketua 或 ketua kampung。以下组合为释义性示例，未验证为现代高频搭配。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=hop)

senses.zh_definition: 主编；总编辑。为 hop-daktur 的历史口语简称。

senses.ms_definition: Ketua pengarang; bentuk bahasa percakapan yang juga disebut hop-daktur.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 现代马来西亚一般不直接称上司为 hop；宜用实际职称，或依关系使用 Encik、Puan 等称呼。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合阅读旧文献、讨论历史用语或准确转述原文。遇到英语 hop 或酿造领域的同形词时，应另按语境辨义，不能套用这里的“首领／主编”义。

etymology.historical_story: Hop preserves a trace of Dutch contact in the region’s vocabulary of authority. Dutch hoofd means head or chief, and historical borrowing research records Indonesian hop with a leadership meaning. Kamus Dewan likewise marks hop as Dutch-derived and records an editorial use through hop-daktur, linking the word with both administration and newspaper leadership. [荷兰皇家科学院借词研究](https://pure.knaw.nl/ws/portalfiles/portal/458170/Nww_compleet_archief.pdf) [DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=hop)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hop 联想到“头儿”：一个管事的头儿；在旧报馆语境里，就是主编。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整借词记忆，hu- 不是马来语前缀；马来语读音以 /h/ 开头，不套用英语中的 /hj/。

senses.zh_definition: 心情；情绪状态，如高兴、悲伤、生气或舒畅。
senses.en_definition: A person's mood or emotional disposition.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan hati, seperti gembira, sedih, marah atau senang.
senses.nuances: 这是输入及 [Kamus Dewan 所列的第一义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=humor)，但现代日常表达心情一般用 suasana hati、perasaan，或口语中的 mood 更清楚。以下搭配用于展示此义，不能据此认定为当代高频表达。

senses.zh_definition: 幽默感；以逗趣方式表达事物、使人发笑的能力。
senses.en_definition: The ability to express things amusingly or make others laugh.
senses.ms_definition: Kebolehan menyatakan sesuatu yang menggelikan hati.
senses.nuances: 强调人的表达能力或幽默感，而不是某个具体笑话。可以说 mempunyai humor；描述某人很幽默时，dia pandai berjenaka 比把 humor 直接当形容词更明确。

collocations.en: an easy, unforced sense of humor

senses.zh_definition: 言语、故事、表演等使人觉得好笑的内容或特质；幽默；诙谐。
senses.en_definition: Amusing content or the quality of being funny in speech, stories, performances, or other works.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang menggelikan hati dalam cerita dan sebagainya; kelucuan.
senses.nuances: 可指作品中的幽默成分，也可指某种幽默风格。Humor 不一定带有讽刺；是否含有 sindiran 须看内容。三个词义依据 [DBP：humor](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=humor)；搭配和例句为编辑编写。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 职场和与长辈交流时，轻松、不过分针对个人的幽默通常更容易被接受；使用前留意关系、场合及对方反应。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于文学评论、表演及日常谈笑。涉及族群、宗教、身体或私人遭遇的玩笑须考虑听者感受；对方不适时，不能仅以 humor 为由要求其接受。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 职场和与长辈交流时，轻松、不过分针对个人的幽默通常更容易被接受；使用前留意关系、场合及对方反应。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于文学评论、表演及日常谈笑。涉及族群、宗教、身体或私人遭遇的玩笑须考虑听者感受；对方不适时，不能仅以 humor 为由要求其接受。

etymology.historical_story: Humor belongs to an international word family ultimately connected with Latin umor, meaning liquid. Ancient and medieval theories linked bodily fluids with temperament, helping explain the later sense of mood. Amusing character and expression became another branch of meaning. Malay preserves both mood and amusement in its dictionary senses; the packet does not establish the immediate borrowing language. [Historical explanation](https://www.etymonline.com/word/humor).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: humor 与中文“幽默”意思相连：先记逗人发笑，再补记词典中的“心情”义；马来语读 hu-mor。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya在这里主要是附着于词后的指代或强调成分，按本结构归入suffix；词根不变，ng /ŋ/与ny /ɲ/分属相邻音节。输入Jawi هوجوڠ仅对应词根hujung，未包含-nya。

senses.zh_definition: 它的末端、尽头或尖端；指上下文已明确的物体或空间的末尾部分。
senses.en_definition: The end, tip, or extremity of something identified in context.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian paling akhir atau paling jauh pada sesuatu benda atau tempat yang telah disebut atau diketahui.
senses.nuances: -nya使所指末端与上下文相连，不必理解为人的所有物。hujung可指路的尽头、绳子的末端或器物尖端；具体形状由名词和情境决定。词根义参见[PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penghujung)。

senses.zh_definition: 某段时间、活动或叙事的末尾；其最后阶段或结局。
senses.en_definition: The final part, stage, or ending of a period, activity, or narrative.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian akhir sesuatu tempoh, kegiatan atau cerita yang dirujuk dalam konteks.
senses.nuances: 把空间上的“末端”延伸到时间或事件。作为名词时，可出现在pada hujungnya或menjelang hujungnya等结构中；不是每一处都应译成副词“终于”。

senses.zh_definition: 到头来；结果；最后，用于口语中引出事情的最终结果。
senses.en_definition: In the end; ultimately, introducing the eventual outcome in informal speech.
senses.ms_definition: Akhirnya atau pada kesudahannya, digunakan secara tidak formal untuk memperkenalkan hasil sesuatu keadaan.
senses.nuances: 属于口语中的结果表达，常带“折腾之后还是如此”的意味。正式书面语通常选akhirnya、pada akhirnya或kesudahannya，以明确表示结果。

collocations.en: it turns out the same in the end
it falls through in the end

etymology.historical_story: Malay hujung connects physical space with the way speakers describe time. The same word identifies the end of a road and the closing part of a year. Hujungnya combines that familiar noun with -nya, allowing the endpoint to refer back to something already mentioned; it does not require a separate borrowed root. [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penghujung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记hujung＝尽头，再把-nya当作“前面说的那个”：hujungnya就是“它的尽头”；说结果时则联想“走到最后，结果出来了”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不带词缀；末尾 ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。加 meN- 时采用 meng-，保留 h：meN- + hitung → menghitung。

senses.zh_definition: 计算、算数，即进行加、减、乘、除等运算。
senses.en_definition: Counting or arithmetic calculation.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal membuat kira-kira, seperti membahagi, mencampur dan mendarab.
senses.nuances: 词根的名词性意义见 DBP。ilmu hitung 指算术；固定表达 hitung panjang 指平均、按平均计算，不是“长时间计算”。现代日常交流更常用 kira，学科名称通常用 matematik。[DBP：hitung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=hitung)

senses.zh_definition: 数出数量；计算总数或数值，常以不带前缀的形式用于指令。
senses.en_definition: To count or calculate, especially in instructions using the bare verb.
senses.ms_definition: Mengira banyaknya sesuatu atau mendapatkan sesuatu jumlah melalui pengiraan.
senses.nuances: 此处说明词根在指令中的动词用法，如 Hitung jumlahnya。一般主动陈述句通常用 menghitung；不能把各派生词的“认为、考虑、归入”等意义全部直接移植给裸词 hitung。马来西亚口语常说 kira。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于算术、清点和核算。核对金钱时，kita kira semula（我们重新算一下）通常比直接指责对方算错更圆融。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向客户、长辈或上司提出计算要求，可说 Sila hitung… 或 Boleh tolong kira…，避免只用生硬的命令。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于算术、清点和核算。核对金钱时，kita kira semula（我们重新算一下）通常比直接指责对方算错更圆融。

etymology.historical_story: Hitung connects numerical calculation with the broader act of reckoning. DBP records both ilmu hitung, arithmetic, and hitung panjang, averaging. Its derivatives extend from counting objects to weighing considerations: perhitungan can concern judgement as well as numbers. This semantic bridge makes the family memorable, although it does not establish a particular ancient origin or borrowing route. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=hitung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hi.tung 想成数珠落盘的“嘻、咚”：一颗一颗数，就是 hitung。声音联想仅用于记忆。

morphology.formula: ∅ + hammer → hammer（英语整词；马来语对应词为 tukul）
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的归根结果。词尾 -er 不是此词中的施事后缀。输入 syllables 的 sst 不是有效音节划分；英语通常分为 ham.mer。IPA 为英语读音，未据此推定马来语规范读音或 Jawi 拼写。

word_family.gloss: 英语相关词形：锤打；连续敲击

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：锤子；通常由硬质锤头和手柄组成，用于敲击、钉钉子等。马来语对应词为 tukul 或 penukul。
senses.en_definition: An English word for a tool with a heavy head and a handle, used for striking or driving nails.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu bagi kata Inggeris ini ialah tukul atau penukul, iaitu alat untuk mengetuk, termasuk mengetuk paku.

etymology.historical_story: English hammer descends from Old English hamor or hamer and belongs to a Germanic word family that includes Dutch hamer and German Hammer. Its history belongs to English, rather than establishing a Malay borrowing. DBP's bilingual dictionary translates the tool as tukul or penukul, providing the appropriate bridge for a trilingual learner. [English origin: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/hammer_1); [Malay equivalents: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=tukul).

etymology.historical_story: Homoseksual belongs to an international family of terms combining Greek homos, meaning same, with a Latin-derived sexual element. Its European terminology is associated with nineteenth-century writer Karl Maria Kertbeny and his 1869 publications. Malay uses the adapted spelling homoseksual, now recorded in DBP dictionaries with both adjective and noun senses. [Historical research](https://commons.clarku.edu/tobinpub/15/), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=homoseksual).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: homo- 记作“相同”，seksual 联系“性吸引”：合起来就是受到同性吸引；这里的 homo- 不是“人”的意思。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不发生鼻音替换；ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/。标准读音可分为 ha.rap.nya，数据包 syllables 为 null，故原样保留。-nya 在不同句法环境中可表示语气、第三人称施事或领属，suffix 是本结构下的归类。数据包 Jawi هارڤ 只对应 harap；补写 -nya 后为 هارڤڽ，此处 headword.jawi 保留原值。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records harap as a literary noun for a wish or desire, alongside familiar derivatives such as berharap and harapan. Harapnya brings that base together with -nya. Its interpretation depends on the sentence: a speaker's hopeful comment, a quotation attributed to someone, or a literary expression of someone's hope. No deeper borrowing history is established by this packet. [DBP：harap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=harap)

etymology.historical_story: Hagen illustrates how a foreign proper name can appear in Malay text without becoming an ordinary Malay word. Duden records Hagen both as a masculine given name, exemplified by Hagen von Tronje in the Nibelung legend, and as a German city name. These attestations establish possible name uses; they do not establish this packet’s intended referent or a Malay etymology. Sources: [given name](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Hagen_Vorname), [city](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Hagen_Stadt).

etymology.historical_story: The name Hanuman comes from Sanskrit and travelled with Ramayana traditions across South and Southeast Asia. In Kelantan, storytellers and puppet makers developed Hanuman Kera Putih, the White Monkey, within local versions of the epic. His puppet therefore records a history of cultural adaptation: an internationally recognised hero expressed through distinctly regional stories and visual conventions. [Name origin](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/hanuman); [Kelantan tradition](https://mjcs.um.edu.my/index.php/MJPVA/article/view/20536)

etymology.historical_story: Humpty belongs to the English name Humpty Dumpty, whose history includes older humorous descriptions of people and a nursery rhyme. The familiar egg figure is a cultural interpretation rather than an explicit description in the rhyme itself. Malay texts retain the foreign name when discussing English stories, songs, or adaptations. See the [Library of Congress account](https://blogs.loc.gov/folklife/2024/03/humpty-dumpty-metafolklore-riddles-and-yolks/?loclr=blogflt).

etymology.historical_story: Hamid can represent two Arabic names in Roman spelling: Ḥamīd, meaning praiseworthy, and Ḥāmid, meaning one who praises. Malay uses Hamid as a personal name, but the Roman letters alone cannot determine an individual's original Arabic spelling. This distinction explains why a missing Jawi form should not be filled by guesswork. See [Ḥamīd](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hamid-1) and [Ḥāmid](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hamid-2).

etymology.historical_story: English holt has two distinct histories. The woodland word continues Old English holt and is related to German Holz, meaning wood. The animal-den word is recorded from the sixteenth century as a pronunciation variant of hold. Their identical modern spelling therefore conceals different origins. Neither history establishes that holt has become a standard Malay word. [Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/holt)

senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan benda atau pihak yang dirujuk oleh -nya hancur, lumat, remuk atau musnah.
senses.nuances: 可用于命令 Hancurkannya!，也可用于前置宾语的第二类被动结构，如 Biskut itu saya hancurkannya，实际正式表达通常简化为 Biskut itu saya hancurkan，以避免重复宾语。主动陈述“他摧毁它”通常写作 Dia menghancurkannya。-nya 不标明性别，也不表示过去时。释义依据 [DBP：hancur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=hancur)。

senses.zh_definition: 使所指物质溶化或溶解。
senses.en_definition: To melt or dissolve the substance referred to by -nya.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan bahan yang dirujuk oleh -nya cair atau larut.
senses.nuances: 这是 hancur 词族的词典义；描述糖、盐等进入溶液时，larutkannya 往往更精确。不能据此把所有液化过程都称为粉碎。参见 [DBP：hancur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=hancur)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻彻底破坏或消除所指的希望、信任、关系或其他抽象事物。
senses.en_definition: To ruin or extinguish the hope, trust, relationship, or other abstract thing referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Merosakkan atau melenyapkan sama sekali harapan, kepercayaan, hubungan atau perkara abstrak yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 语气强烈，强调整体或严重破坏。-nya 的所指须由上下文提供；不能固定译成“他的”。以下是附着形式的示范组合，未核实其独立频率。参见 [DBP：hancur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=hancur)。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates productive Malay grammar rather than a separate borrowing. Hancur describes a broken, ruined, or dissolved state. Adding -kan creates a causative instruction, and -nya supplies a context-dependent object. The same structure can describe crushing biscuits or destroying hope. Its meaning grows from composition; no special historical anecdote is needed.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hancur＝碎或毁，-kan＝使它变成这样，-nya＝它／他／她：hancurkannya＝“把它弄碎／毁掉它”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语文本中按未加词缀的外来专名整体处理；is_root 不代表它是马来语固有词根。词尾 -way 不是马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为英语英式读音，并非已核实的马来语标准读音。

etymology.historical_story: Holloway carries a landscape inside a name. English surname references connect it with a hollow or sunken road, describing either where someone lived or a place from which they came. Such geographical descriptions could become inherited family names. This explains the English surname's background, but does not identify which Holloway the Malay source intended. [Source: Dictionary of American Family Names](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/holloway).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 hollow“凹下的”与 way“路”想象一条低于两侧地面的路，再把画面挂到 Holloway 这个名字上；这是词源记忆，不是马来语拆词。

morphology.pattern_note: heran 应整词记忆，不能拆成 her + -an；输入中的 her 不是本词的词根。马来西亚规范拼写为 hairan，口语可把 ai 单元音化为 [e]。以下词族采用规范拼写 hairan。

senses.zh_definition: 因见到或听到不寻常、出乎意料或难以理解的事情而感到惊讶、诧异或纳闷。
senses.en_definition: Surprised, astonished, or puzzled by something unusual or unexpected.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa pelik, takjub atau tidak mengerti apabila melihat atau mendengar sesuatu yang luar biasa atau tidak disangka-sangka.
senses.nuances: 可表示赞叹，也可表示困惑，并不必然含有恐惧。马来西亚正式书写用 hairan；heran 是口语拼写，也用于印度尼西亚规范书写。搭配保留本词形，正式文件应相应改成 hairan。[DBP：hairan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=hairan)；[马来语理事会：马印拼写差异](https://www.languagecouncils.sg/mbms/en/-/media/mlc/documents/penerbitan_ejaan-rumi-bahasa-melayu_muhammad-ariff-ahmad.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 事情本身显得奇怪、反常或令人难以置信。
senses.en_definition: Strange, extraordinary, or difficult to account for.
senses.ms_definition: Pelik, ganjil atau luar biasa sehingga menimbulkan rasa hairan.
senses.nuances: 常见于感叹式表达，意思接近“真奇怪”。修饰事物时，规范马来语也常用 pelik 或 menghairankan，以便清楚区分“感到惊讶”与“令人惊讶”。[DBP：hairan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=hairan)

etymology.historical_story: An early Malay-English dictionary records hairan as an Arabic borrowing and also lists heran as a variant. Later spelling discussions document the difference between Malaysian hairan and Indonesian heran. The variation therefore concerns a whole borrowed word, not a Malay suffix attached to her. [Historical dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/An_abridged_Malay-English_dictionary_%28romanized%29_%28IA_afu7967.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 heran，就想象自己“咦？”地一愣：觉得奇怪、感到惊讶；正式写作记得还原成 hairan。

senses.zh_definition: 寄来、送来或汇来的东西；寄送物或汇款。

senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang dikirim atau disampaikan kepada penerima.

collocations.zh: 家人寄来的东西或款项

senses.zh_definition: 马来婚俗中男方交给女方家庭、用于婚礼开支的礼金。

senses.zh_definition: 马来婚礼中作为礼物呈送的食品、衣物等，常摆放在礼盘上。
senses.en_definition: Ceremonial wedding gifts, such as food or clothing, commonly presented on trays.
senses.ms_definition: Hadiah seperti makanan dan pakaian yang dibawa dalam upacara perkahwinan Melayu.
senses.nuances: 与礼金义相关，但此义指实物礼品。dulang 指盛放礼物的盘；谈及回礼时可见 hantaran balas。

senses.zh_definition: 足球等球类运动中，将球踢、抛或传给队友或指定位置的动作；传球。
senses.en_definition: A pass of the ball to another player or a particular position.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menendang atau membaling bola kepada pemain lain atau ke tempat tertentu.
senses.nuances: 常用于体育报道和战术讨论。hantaran 不等于射门；hantaran silang 指横传或传中，具体译法取决于场上位置。

senses.zh_definition: 发布在社交媒体上的一则内容；帖文或帖子。
senses.en_definition: An item of content published on social media; a post.
senses.ms_definition: Kandungan yang disiarkan sebagai satu entri pada platform media sosial.
senses.nuances: 此义获 DBP 语言咨询确认；可指文字、图片、视频或组合内容。hantaran 是内容本身，发布动作可表达为 membuat hantaran。[DBP：媒体帖文用语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=hantaran)

etymology.historical_story: Hantaran is formed from hantar, meaning to send, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its meanings share the idea of something being conveyed: a remittance, wedding gifts, or a ball passed to another player. Digital communication gives that same image a familiar contemporary setting, as content sent into a social feed is called a hantaran.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 hantar「送」：送来的款物、送去的婚礼礼品、传出去的球、发出去的帖文，都能串到 hantaran。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不变；meN- 在 h 前变为 meng-，保留 h：menghulur。menghulurkan 加 -kan，常表示把某物伸出、递出或放长。裸词 hulur 常用于口语或简短指令。

word_family.gloss: 伸出、递送或提供的行为

senses.zh_definition: 向外伸出或探出身体部位。
senses.en_definition: To extend or reach out a body part.
senses.ms_definition: Mengunjurkan anggota badan ke luar.
senses.nuances: 突出向外伸出的动作。正式及物表达通常用 menghulurkan；hulur tangan 也可引申为援助或和好。本条围绕输入对应的动作义词根，义项区分参照 [DBP：hulur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=hulur)。

senses.zh_definition: 伸手把东西递给别人；引申为给予帮助或支持。
senses.en_definition: To hand something to someone; to offer help or support.
senses.ms_definition: Menyerahkan sesuatu dengan tangan atau memberikan bantuan.
senses.nuances: 实物义强调递出的动作；抽象义常与 bantuan、pertolongan 连用。通常不表示付款、履行义务等所有类型的给予。

senses.zh_definition: 逐渐放出绳子、鱼线等，使外露部分变长。
senses.en_definition: To let out a rope, line, or string.
senses.ms_definition: Melepaskan tali atau benang supaya bahagian yang terjulur bertambah panjang.
senses.nuances: 指增加放出的长度，不一定完全松手，也不一定把绳子本身拉伸。收线通常用 menarik 或 menggulung。

senses.zh_definition: 物体受拉而伸长或延展。
senses.en_definition: To stretch or become longer under tension.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi lebih panjang apabila ditarik.
senses.nuances: 此义通常用不及物形式 menghulur，主语是发生伸长的物体；区别于把某物向外伸出的及物形式 menghulurkan。

senses.zh_definition: 延长时间、寿命或讨论等的持续长度；反复形式也可表示拖延。
senses.en_definition: To prolong a duration, lifespan, or discussion; in repeated form, to delay.
senses.ms_definition: Menambah tempoh sesuatu; dalam bentuk berulang, melengah-lengahkan.
senses.nuances: 时间延展义较具书面色彩，日常也常用 memanjangkan 或 melanjutkan。menghulur-hulur 强调一再拖延，通常带不满语气。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary records a useful cultural bridge between physical movement and generosity: hulur describes extending something, while menghulurkan bantuan describes offering help. A hand reaches outward; assistance reaches another person. This is a semantic connection, not a documented chronology of origin. Remember the shared image rather than inventing a foreign source for the root. See [DBP: hulur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=hulur).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve hara through a cross-reference to haru and huru-hara. etymology.historical_story: English hand continues Old English hand or hond. Modern hands uses the regular ending -s, both for plural nouns and for third-person singular verbs. Its meanings range from body parts to workers, clock pointers, and control. In Malaysian conversation, an occurrence can be English code-switching rather than evidence of a Malay root. See [Dictionary.com: hand](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/hand).

etymology.historical_story: The base hadiah is a borrowing from Arabic hadiyyah, meaning a gift. Malay incorporates the borrowed noun into its own productive grammar: adding -kan produces hadiahkan, while other affixes form menghadiahkan and menghadiahi. The family illustrates how an imported word becomes fully usable in everyday Malay, from birthday presents to expressions of appreciation.

senses.en_definition: To wade across water or make one's way through obstructing vegetation.
senses.ms_definition: Berjalan melalui atau menyeberangi kawasan berair atau bersemak dengan meranduk atau meredahnya.
senses.nuances: 强调人在阻力中前进，不泛指任何越过动作。harungi 可见于祈使句及第一、第二人称施事的被动结构，如 Sungai itu kami harungi；普通主动句用 mengharungi。词义依据 [DBP：harung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=harung)。

senses.zh_definition: 航行穿过海洋或其他广大水域。
senses.en_definition: To traverse a sea or other extensive body of water by vessel.
senses.ms_definition: Menempuh sesuatu kawasan laut atau sungai dengan menggunakan kapal, perahu atau kenderaan air yang lain.
senses.nuances: 强调穿越水域的航程，不表示人在深海中步行。此义与涉水义须按交通方式区分。词义依据 [DBP：harung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=harung)。

senses.zh_definition: 面对并经历艰难、挑战或痛苦的处境。
senses.en_definition: To face and go through difficulties, challenges or hardship.
senses.ms_definition: Menghadapi serta melalui sesuatu pengalaman yang sukar, mencabar atau menyakitkan.
senses.nuances: 常带坚持向前的意味，但词本身不保证最终成功。比喻义依据 [DBP：harung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=harung)。

etymology.historical_story: The root harung brings together physical passage through water or undergrowth and the experience of hardship. Its dictionary senses offer a useful cultural image: moving forward despite resistance. Reading life's difficulties as something to cross is a semantic connection, rather than evidence for a particular ancient origin. Harungi adds the Malay suffix -i. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=harung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ha-ru-ngi，想象三步涉水前进：迈进去、顶住阻力、走过去；困难也一样要 harungi。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 此处通常是后附的第三人称宾语代词；ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/，不是 /n.j/，词根不发生音变。实际音节为 han.tar.nya；syllables 保留资料包的 null，jawi 保留资料包提供的词根写法。

senses.zh_definition: 把它寄出、送交或传送出去；常用于指令，宾语由前文确定。
senses.en_definition: Send, deliver, or transmit it, especially in an instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Mengirim atau membawa sesuatu yang telah disebut ke tempat atau kepada penerima tertentu.
senses.nuances: 例如 Borang itu sudah lengkap; hantarnya sekarang。-nya 指前文的表格。普通主动陈述通常用 menghantarnya；hantarnya 本身不自动表示“他寄送”，也不带过去时。释义综合词根义与宾语代词功能。[DBP：hantar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=hantar-menghantar+1)

collocations.en: take him or her to hospital

senses.ms_definition: Mengutus atau menempatkan seseorang yang telah disebut di sesuatu tempat untuk bertugas atau belajar.
senses.nuances: 强调安排前往的目的，不必表示说话者亲自陪同；与“送到目的地”义有交集。

senses.en_definition: Pass or play it to another player or position, referring to a ball.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan atau menggerakkan bola yang telah disebut kepada pemain lain atau ke arah tertentu.
senses.nuances: 属于运动语境中的词根义延伸；比赛现场更常直接说 Hantar bola! 或 Hantar kepada Amir!。

etymology.historical_story: Hantarnya combines the Malay verb hantar with the attached pronoun -nya. The verb connects several everyday journeys: delivering a letter, taking someone home and sending a learner elsewhere. Its modern use also accommodates electronic files. The changing object reflects changing circumstances, while the central idea remains movement towards a destination. [DBP: hantar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=hantar-menghantar+1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hantar 是“送”，-nya 接住前文的人或物：hantarnya＝“把他／她／它送去”。

senses.zh_definition: 异端者：其宗教信仰或主张被某一宗教权威或传统认定为违背正统教义的人。
senses.en_definition: A person whose religious beliefs are judged contrary to the established doctrines of a religious tradition.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris bagi seseorang yang pegangan agamanya dianggap bertentangan dengan ajaran yang diterima sebagai ortodoks oleh sesuatu tradisi agama.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词义的马来语解释，并非声称存在 DBP 马来语同形词条。它不等同于“无神论者”“异教徒”或“叛教者”，翻译须依宗教背景确定。下列搭配是马来语中引用英语词的表达，不宣称是高频马来语本族搭配。[Oxford 释义与词源](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.co.uk/definition/english/heretic)；[Cambridge 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/heretic)

senses.zh_definition: 引申指挑战某个领域公认观念、主流理论或既定做法的人。
senses.en_definition: By extension, a person who challenges accepted opinions or established practices in a particular field.
senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan dalam bahasa Inggeris, seseorang yang mencabar pandangan atau amalan yang diterima umum dalam sesuatu bidang.
senses.nuances: 英语引申义可带批评、幽默或赞赏色彩；在马来语正文中，宜按语境解释为 pencabar pandangan arus perdana 等。下列为语码转换表达。[英语引申义与历史](https://www.etymonline.com/word/heretic)

etymology.historical_story: English heretic reached Middle English through French and ecclesiastical Latin, ultimately from Greek hairetikos, associated with choosing. Religious usage narrowed the word to someone judged to depart from accepted doctrine. Its history helps explain the force of the label: it reflects a community's boundary of orthodoxy, rather than simply describing someone with no religious belief. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.co.uk/definition/english/heretic)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 heretic 与“挑战正统的人”绑定；再记 heresy 是思想，heretic 是持有这种思想的人。

senses.zh_definition: 供船只停泊、避风的受遮蔽水域；港湾。
senses.en_definition: A sheltered area of water where vessels can anchor safely.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan perairan terlindung tempat kapal atau bot boleh berlabuh dengan selamat.
senses.nuances: 英语词，美式拼写；英式拼写为 harbour。马来语通常用 pelabuhan，强调避风停泊处时也可用 tempat perlindungan kapal。ms_definition 是马来语释义，并非 DBP 对 harbor 的官方释义。以下 ms 搭配提供马来语对应表达。读音及主要义项参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/harbor)。

senses.zh_definition: 提供藏身或庇护之处；收留，尤指藏匿被追捕的人。
senses.en_definition: To shelter or hide someone, especially someone being sought.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan tempat perlindungan atau persembunyian kepada seseorang.
senses.nuances: 及物动词；常见于藏匿逃亡者的语境，但并非所有用例都涉及违法行为。以下为马来语对应搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 心中怀有或长期保留某种想法、感情。
senses.en_definition: To retain a thought or feeling, often privately or over time.
senses.ms_definition: Menyimpan sesuatu fikiran atau perasaan dalam hati.
senses.nuances: 常与怀疑、怨恨等搭配，也可用于希望或抱负。马来语通常用 menyimpan、memendam 或 menaruh，具体取决于宾语。

senses.zh_definition: 含有某种生物或为其提供生存处所，尤指病菌、寄生生物等。
senses.en_definition: To contain organisms or provide conditions in which they can live.
senses.ms_definition: Mengandungi organisma atau menjadi tempat organisma hidup.
senses.nuances: 常见于科学及卫生语境，是含有、容纳义，不是有意窝藏。其用例可见 [Cambridge Dictionary 的语料例句](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/harbor)。

etymology.historical_story: Harbor developed from an Old English expression for lodging or shelter, built from elements associated with an army and protection. Its maritime meaning specialized that sheltering idea for ships. The verb also extended to sheltering people and keeping thoughts or feelings within oneself. The shared image is something held in a protected place. See [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/harbor).

etymology.historical_story: Hatch brings several histories into one spelling. The opening noun continues Old English hæc, while the birth verb appears as Middle English hacchen. The drawing verb instead comes through French hacher, associated with cutting or incising. Their shared spelling can suggest one story, but the separate origins explain why doors, chicks and shading require different interpretations. Source: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/hatch).

etymology.historical_story: Horus was closely associated with Egyptian kingship, and the falcon became a powerful royal image. In one surviving statue, a small king stands beneath the bird's breast, expressing divine protection. Egyptian royal names also incorporated the Horus falcon, linking a ruler's identity with the god rather than merely decorating a written name. [The Met](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/544887), [UCL](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/museums-static/digitalegypt/ideology/kingname/horus.html)

etymology.historical_story: Hat illustrates the difference between a regional grammatical word and an English look-alike. Research on northern dialect influence records hat ni in a speaker’s description of clothing. Such everyday expressions preserve local ways of identifying things. The evidence supports this regional use, but does not establish a historical derivation from English hat or from another Malay word. [UKM study](https://ejournal.ukm.my/jmelayu/article/download/60142/13677).

etymology.historical_story: Malay extends hutang from borrowed money to obligations created by kindness. The expression hutang budi makes gratitude something remembered and reciprocated, while dictionary proverbs contrast repayable material debts with lasting obligations of gratitude. Hutangnya adds a referent to this established noun; the ending identifies whose debt is meant without specifying gender. See [DBP: hutang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=hutang).

etymology.historical_story: English hand continues Old English hand or hond, documented in the Anglo-Saxon dictionary tradition. Its long history belongs to English, while Malay normally uses tangan for the body part. Finding hand in Malaysian bilingual material therefore does not, by itself, demonstrate borrowing into standard Malay; it may simply be an English item being translated. [Bosworth–Toller: hand, hond](https://bosworthtoller.com/018110).

etymology.historical_story: Histeria belongs to an international medical vocabulary whose history reaches back to the Greek word for uterus. Its ancestry reflects an erroneous belief that such disturbances were peculiar to women and originated in the womb. The word later acquired a broader meaning involving overwhelming emotion. Modern psychological terminology treats hysteria as a historical label rather than one precise diagnosis. [APA](https://dictionary.apa.org/hysteria).

etymology.historical_story: Hungary belongs to a European family of external names associated with Medieval Latin Hungaria and the ethnonym Onogur. It is unrelated to the English adjective hungry, despite their similar appearance. Malaysian official Malay retains Hungary, while Hungarians call their country Magyarország, illustrating how one country can have quite different internal and external names. See [place-name history](https://places.behindthename.com/name/hungary).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Hungary 是匈牙利，hungry 才是饿：国名多一个 a，想到地图上的一个国家。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无词缀。派生时 meN- 在 /h/ 前取 meng-，保留 h，如 menghapuskan；peN- 相应取 peng-，如 penghapusan。词包 Jawi دهاڤوس 带有额外的起首 د，与 Rumi 词头不对应；此处按输入保留，不将该形式视为已核实的规范拼写。

word_family.gloss: 消除；废除；删除这一行为

senses.zh_definition: 消失；消除殆尽；不再存在或显现。
senses.en_definition: To disappear or cease to remain visible or present.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak lagi wujud atau kelihatan; menjadi hilang atau lenyap.
senses.nuances: 基本义着重消失后的状态，并不总表示主动清除动作。正式语中若要表达“消除某物”，通常使用 menghapuskan；表示“已经被清除”可用 terhapus。不能把 hapus 在所有句型中都直接当作及物动词使用。[DBP：hapus 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=+hapus)

senses.zh_definition: 获得宽恕或赦免；指罪过、过错不再被追究。
senses.en_definition: To be forgiven or remitted, especially of sins or wrongdoing.
senses.ms_definition: Telah mendapat keampunan atau kemaafan, khususnya berkenaan dosa atau kesalahan.
senses.nuances: 常见于宗教或道德语境，强调罪过获赦，并非记忆或历史事实被抹去。主动表示“赦免罪过”通常用 menghapuskan dosa，结果状态可用 dosa terhapus。[DBP：hapus 的赦免义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=+hapus)

senses.zh_definition: 删除；把数据、文件或其他对象从其所在位置移除，常用于界面命令。
senses.en_definition: To delete or remove an object, especially data or a file, from its location.
senses.ms_definition: Membuang sesuatu objek, seperti fail atau rekod, daripada tempatnya dalam sistem komputer.
senses.nuances: 计算机术语和按钮标签可直接用 Hapus；完整正式陈述通常用 menghapuskan 或 dipadamkan 等适合语境的形式。删除不必然等于安全销毁，是否可恢复取决于系统。hapus kira 是另一个固定会计术语，不能与删除文件混同。[DBP：Kamus Komputer 的 hapus 义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=+hapus)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect hapus with disappearance and with the forgiveness of wrongdoing. Computing terminology also uses it for deleting an object from its location. These meanings offer a shared image: something no longer remains in the relevant place or account. This is a semantic connection, not evidence of a documented chronological development or a particular ancient borrowing. [DBP dictionary evidence](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=+hapus)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /ha.pus/ 想成擦除时的两拍：“ha——擦过去，pus——痕迹不见了。”这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

senses.zh_definition: 知识、兴趣、经验或认知所及的范围；视野；眼界。
senses.en_definition: The range or limits of a person's knowledge, interests, experience, or perception.
senses.ms_definition: Lingkungan atau batas pengetahuan, minat, pengalaman dan persepsi seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这是输入《Kamus Dewan》词条的核心义，常见于教育、文化和思想讨论。比 pandangan 更强调认知范围，而非某一项意见。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=horizon)

senses.zh_definition: 远处天空与陆地或海面看似相接的界线；地平线。
senses.en_definition: The apparent line where the sky meets the land or sea.
senses.ms_definition: Garis batas pandangan tempat langit kelihatan bertemu dengan permukaan bumi atau laut; ufuk.
senses.nuances: 可见于 garisan horizon 等表达；规范天文及一般描写也常用 ufuk 或 kaki langit。此义须与抽象的认知视野区分。[马来西亚联邦直辖区宗教司署](https://muftiwp.gov.my/en/artikel/bayan-al-falak/3234-bayan-al-falak-siri-ke-4-kupasan-ringkas-berkenaan-bumi-datar-dari-perspektif-ilmu-falak)

senses.zh_definition: 土壤剖面中与地表大致平行、具有特定性质的土层；土壤发生层。
senses.en_definition: A soil layer approximately parallel to the surface and distinguished by particular characteristics.
senses.ms_definition: Lapisan tanah yang sejajar dengan permukaan bumi dan mempunyai ciri tertentu.
senses.nuances: 农业、土壤学及地质学术语，通常与 tanah、tanih 或层位字母连用；这里不表示地平线。[DBP 土壤术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=horizon)

etymology.historical_story: Horizon ultimately comes from Greek horizōn, associated with a bounding circle, and belongs to an international vocabulary transmitted through Latin and European languages. Its geographical image offers a useful bridge to the Malay figurative sense: knowledge and experience also have limits that can expand. Soil science gives the word another specialised application to distinct layers. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/horizon), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=horizon)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 顺着 ho-ri-zon 三拍想象向远处望：眼睛看到的边界是地平线，思想能到达的边界就是眼界。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是 kamu 的后附着代词，表示“你的”，严格说是附着语而非派生后缀；按给定字段归入 suffix。拼写连写，读作 ha.ri.mu。输入 Jawi هاري 仅覆盖 hari；完整 harimu 可写作 هاريمو。[DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mu)

senses.zh_definition: 你的一天；你在某一天经历的生活、活动或感受。
senses.en_definition: Your day, especially the activities or experiences that make up a particular day.
senses.ms_definition: Hari kamu, khususnya kegiatan, pengalaman atau keadaan yang kamu lalui pada sesuatu hari.
senses.nuances: 这是 hari 与 -mu 的组合，不是必须单独记忆的新词根。输入的 DBP 定义针对 hari；本条组合义据构词解释。harimu 可带亲切或抒情色彩；马来西亚日常聊天也常用 hari awak。-mu 须与前词连写。[DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mu)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 不自动表示尊敬，常见于亲近关系、歌词和抒情文字。称呼客户、长辈或上级时，可按关系改用 hari anda、hari puan 或其他合适称谓。

etymology.historical_story: Harimu brings together hari, meaning day, and the attached pronoun -mu, a shortened form of kamu. Malay spelling joins this pronoun to the preceding word, just as in bukumu, your book. The construction makes a shared unit of time personal: a day becomes your day, suitable for a greeting or an affectionate wish. [DBP 用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hari 是“一天”，-mu 是“你的”：hari + mu，立刻把日历上的一天变成“你的一天”。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是外来专名，作为完整名称记忆，不拆成马来语 hamil 与其他成分。正文通常大写 Hamilton；所列 IPA 为常见英语读法，并非马来语官方定音。

senses.en_definition: Hamilton: a surname, also used as a given name, whose bearer is identified by context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga, dan juga nama peribadi, dalam bahasa Inggeris; orang yang dimaksudkan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 词性细分为 kata nama khas，即专有名词。不能仅凭此词判定是 Lewis Hamilton、Alexander Hamilton 或其他人物。输入未提供 DBP 释义；official 为指定输出标签，不表示它是马来语普通词。姓氏背景参见 [Oxford Dictionary of National Biography](https://academic.oup.com/oxford-dictionary-of-national-biography/reference/63486/reference-article-abstract/580536009)。

senses.zh_definition: 汉密尔顿：多个地方使用的地名，须结合国家或地区辨认。
senses.en_definition: Hamilton: a place name used by several settlements, identified by geographical context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama tempat yang digunakan oleh beberapa bandar atau petempatan dan perlu dikenal pasti berdasarkan konteks geografi.
senses.nuances: 地名通常保留 Hamilton，不作意译。新西兰的 Hamilton 也称 Kirikiriroa；无上下文时不能自动把词项限定为该城市。[Hamilton City Council](https://hamilton.govt.nz/your-council/about-council/our-partners/maaori)

senses.ms_definition: Judul sebuah muzikal yang berpusat pada kisah Alexander Hamilton.
senses.nuances: 这是作品名称的指称用法。muzikal Hamilton、tiket Hamilton 等上下文可将它与人名或地名区分。[Hamilton 官方网站](https://hamiltonmusical.com/new-york/cast/)

etymology.historical_story: Hamilton has a documented medieval Scottish history: Walter Fitz Gilbert appears in a 1296 record with the name de Hameldone. Its earlier geographical origin is less certain, so a neat literal translation would overstate the evidence. For Malay readers, Hamilton functions as a complete proper name whose reference depends on context. [Oxford Dictionary of National Biography](https://academic.oup.com/oxford-dictionary-of-national-biography/reference/63486/reference-article-abstract/580536009)

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records hum as an interjection of regret, with the Jawi spelling هوم. Its expressive sound invites comparison with sighs or grunts, but that resemblance does not establish a historical derivation. The available entry supplies no borrowing history; the identical English spelling should therefore not be treated as evidence of common origin. senses.zh_definition: 氢：元素符号为 H、原子序数为 1 的化学元素；其单质在常温常压下通常为无色、无臭、易燃的双原子气体 H₂，是最轻的气体。
senses.en_definition: Hydrogen: the chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1, ordinarily occurring as H₂, a colourless, odourless, highly flammable gas and the lightest gas.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur kimia bersimbol H dan bernombor atom 1 yang pada suhu dan tekanan biasa wujud sebagai gas H₂ yang paling ringan, tidak berwarna, tidak berbau dan mudah terbakar serta membentuk air apabila bertindak balas dengan oksigen.
senses.nuances: 既可指氢元素，也可依语境指氢气。hidrogen peroksida 指过氧化氢这种化合物，并非氢气的另一名称。马来语释义依据 DBP 定义并补充元素信息编写。[DBP：hidrogen](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=hidrogen)；[Royal Society of Chemistry：Hydrogen](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/1)。

etymology.historical_story: The international name behind hidrogen means 'water-former'. Antoine Lavoisier named the gas to express its role in producing water when combined with oxygen. That connection helped overturn the older view that water was an elementary substance. Malay uses hidrogen as a complete scientific loanword, carrying this history into chemistry classrooms. [Royal Society of Chemistry](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 hidrogen 的 hidro- 联想到 hydro（水）：氢与氧结合生成水，因此记作“成水元素”；这是词源联想，不是马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】荣誉、尊重或名誉；也可指恪守道德原则的操守，或使人感到光荣的待遇、机会及表彰。

senses.nuances: 此处为英语词义说明，并非已核实的马来语官方释义。表达尊重可用 penghormatan，表达荣誉或名誉可按语境用 kehormatan 或 nama baik。下列搭配是马来语对应表达，不是 honor 的马来语搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】尊重或表彰某人；也指履行承诺、协议等，或承兑付款凭证。
senses.en_definition: English verb: to respect or recognize someone, fulfill an undertaking, or accept and pay a financial instrument.
senses.ms_definition: Kata kerja bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud menghormati atau memberikan penghargaan kepada seseorang, menunaikan janji, memenuhi kewajipan atau membuat pembayaran yang berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 译为马来语时须按宾语选择动词：尊重父母用 menghormati；兑现承诺用 menunaikan；不能把英语 honor 直接当作规范马来语动词套用。下列搭配为马来语对应表达。

etymology.historical_story: English honor travelled through Anglo-French onur and honur from Latin honos or honor. Its recorded English history reaches back to the twelfth century as a noun and the thirteenth as a verb. This history helps connect public esteem with acts of respect, but does not establish honor as a standard Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster: honor](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/honor)

etymology.historical_story: Malay connects pleasant fragrance with an admired reputation through harum. Flowers can be harum, and so can a person's name. The proverb harum menghilangkan bau describes goodness concealing faults, preserving the same contrast between pleasant and unpleasant smells. This documents the word's cultural imagery rather than establishing its ultimate linguistic origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=harum)

etymology.historical_story: Haryana is an Indian place name, not a Malay formation. The Haryana government's historical account records several interpretations of its origin, so a single literal translation should not be presented as settled fact. The modern state was established on 1 November 1966, while the regional name has a much older documented history. [Haryana Government: History](https://www.haryana.gov.in/history/) [Haryana Government: About Haryana](https://www.haryana.gov.in/about-haryana/)

etymology.historical_story: The expression is generally traced to Persian harām-zāda, combining a word meaning forbidden or illegitimate with one meaning offspring. Malay dictionaries preserve both the literal reference to birth outside marriage and the broader abusive use. That semantic history explains why the insult can attack family dignity even when the speaker intends only to express anger. [Wiktionary: haram jadah](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/haram_jadah), [DBP/PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=haram+jadah)。

etymology.historical_story: Handphone combines the English words hand and phone, presenting the device as a telephone carried in the hand. In Malaysian conversation it can appear inside otherwise Malay sentences. DBP supplies telefon bimbit as the Malay equivalent. The contrast gives learners a useful register distinction between everyday multilingual speech and standard Malay writing. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=telefon+bimbit).

senses.nuances: 常见于祈使句，如 Habiskannya!；普通正式主动陈述通常用 menghabiskannya。-nya 的对象必须由上下文确定；“耗尽”本身不必然表示浪费。定义依据 DBP 对 menghabiskan 的释义综合编写，并非独立词条原文。[DBP：menghabiskan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=146196&keyword=menghabiskan)

collocations.zh: 一点一点把它吃完或用完

senses.zh_definition: 把它做完；完成所指工作、作业或阅读等有终点的活动。
senses.en_definition: To complete the task or activity referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Menyiapkan, menyudahkan atau menyelesaikan kerja atau kegiatan yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 强调达到完成点，不表示把某种物质耗尽。Habiskannya sebelum esok 可指把前文提到的工作做完；若要特别强调工作成果，siapkannya 或 selesaikannya 往往更明确。

collocations.zh: 在截止日期前把它完成

senses.zh_definition: 把它讲完或结束；使所指故事、谈话或其他过程终止。
senses.en_definition: To bring the story, conversation, or process referred to to an end.
senses.ms_definition: Menamatkan atau mengakhiri cerita, percakapan atau proses yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: 与“完成任务”相近，但侧重结束叙述或过程。需要前文提供明确对象；单独说 habiskannya 不能判断是在讲完故事、吃完东西还是完成工作。

collocations.en: bring it to a brief conclusion
tell it through to the end

senses.zh_definition: 干掉他或她；杀死所指的人，属于带威胁性的语境义。
senses.en_definition: To kill or finish off the person referred to.
senses.ms_definition: Menghabisi atau membunuh orang yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: DBP 在 menghabiskan 下收录杀死义。只有上下文明确指向暴力时，habiskannya 才作此解；不能把一般的“把它做完”理解为威胁。以下为帮助辨认该语义的短语，不应视为日常高频搭配。

collocations.en: do not kill him or her

etymology.historical_story: Habiskannya illustrates how Malay builds a precise instruction from several grammatical pieces. Habis expresses an endpoint; -kan forms a transitive verb directed at something; -nya points back to an understood object. The same structure can concern food, money, work, or a story. These are productive grammatical relationships, not evidence of a separate ancient compound.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: habis“完”＋-kan“使它达到这个状态”＋-nya“它”：把它弄完。具体是吃完、用完还是做完，看前文对象。

etymology.historical_story: English dictionaries distinguish hip meaning fashionable from hip naming a body part. The same spelling therefore leads learners into two different semantic contexts. For this Malay entry, the important boundary is borrowing versus translation: a fashionable café may be described with English hip, whereas the ordinary Malay anatomical term is pinggul.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看语境分两格：咖啡馆 hip 是“潮”，身体的 hip 是“髋”；马来语说髋部可记 pinggul。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词；此处采用英式读音，词尾 e 不发音。没有马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 马：可供骑乘、拉车等的有蹄哺乳动物；这是英语词义，标准马来语对应词为 kuda。

senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud kuda, iaitu haiwan berkuku yang digunakan untuk tunggangan, tarikan dan kerja lain; huraian ini bukan petikan takrif rasmi DBP bagi horse.
senses.nuances: 本条说明英语常用动物义，不代表 horse 已成为标准马来语词头。下列 ms 搭配采用马来语对应词 kuda；正式马来语通常使用该对应词。英语另有体操器械等义，不宜在缺少语境时自动套用。参考：[Oxford 的 horse 词条](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/horse_1)、[DBP 的 kuda 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=kuda+I)。

etymology.historical_story: Horse continues Old English hors and belongs to an inherited Germanic word family, with relatives such as Dutch ros and German Ross. Its history is therefore separate from that of Malay kuda. Finding horse inside a Malay text does not by itself establish borrowing; the writer may simply be quoting or switching languages. Reference: [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/horse_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 /hɔːs/，想象一匹马；把 horse—kuda—马连成同一幅图，词尾 e 不发音。

morphology.pattern_note: 按完整词根记忆；不能仅凭词尾字母 an 就拆出后缀 -an。音节标注保留输入形式；较清晰的读音可分辨出 /u.a/。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary connects habuan with an allocated share, including provisions distributed among crew members. That image provides a useful cultural bridge: something divided becomes someone's due, then a benefit or opportunity, and finally one's lot in life. This is a semantic interpretation of documented meanings; a deeper historical origin is not established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ha-bu-an，想象分食物时有人喊“还有你那份！”：habuan 就是分到你手里的那一份。此为联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留词包的直接基底 hapuskan；更深层词根是 hapus。-kan 构成及物动词，-nya 是后接的第三人称附着代词，此处通常作宾语；ny 表示单一鼻音 /ɲ/，不发生词根音变。

word_family.gloss: 删除；消除；废除这一过程

senses.zh_definition: 把它擦去、删除或清除；所指对象通常是前文提到的文字、痕迹、记录或文件。
senses.en_definition: Erase, delete, or remove it, referring to previously identified writing, marks, records, or files.
senses.ms_definition: Menghilangkan tulisan, kesan, rekod atau fail yang telah disebut dengan memadam, menggosok atau tindakan lain yang sesuai.
senses.nuances: 常用于祈使句，如 Sila hapuskannya；也可出现在 Fail itu perlu saya hapuskannya 之外的合规范结构中，例如 Saya diminta supaya hapuskannya 不宜作为正式范句，正式叙述通常用 menghapuskannya。-nya 在这里指被删除的对象，并非自动表示“他的”。本条为组合词形释义，基础义项参照 [DBP：menghapuskan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menghapuskan)。

senses.zh_definition: 把它消灭、根除或废除；对象可以是不良现象、制度、威胁或其他需要彻底消除的事物。
senses.en_definition: Eliminate, eradicate, or abolish the previously mentioned problem, practice, institution, or threat.
senses.ms_definition: Meniadakan, membanteras atau membasmi sesuatu masalah, amalan, sistem atau ancaman yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 比一般的减少或改善更强调使对象不再存在。termasuk penyakit、rasuah、diskriminasi 等语境；不是只要“不喜欢”就适合使用的轻微表达。

senses.zh_definition: 将所指的债务、责任或罪过视为不再存在；依语境表示免除、注销或赦免。
senses.en_definition: Cancel the referenced debt or obligation, or forgive the referenced sin or wrongdoing.
senses.ms_definition: Menganggap hutang, tanggungan atau dosa yang telah disebut sebagai tidak ada lagi, atau memberikan pengampunan terhadapnya.
senses.nuances: 此义取决于明确的前文对象。债务豁免涉及取消偿还责任；实际会计处理中的“核销”可能需要更专门的 hapus kira，不能机械互换。

collocations.zh: 将它从债务清单中注销
collocations.en: remove it from the list of debts

etymology.historical_story: Hapuskannya is a grammatical combination rather than a separate historical borrowing. Hapus supplies the idea of disappearance or removal, -kan forms the transitive verb, and -nya identifies its object. The same vocabulary now serves digital deletion as well as physical erasure. Malay spelling joins the pronoun to its host. [DBP spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The abbreviation hr compresses hari by retaining its consonants, a strategy suited to short written messages. DBP's 2008 SMS guide explicitly lists this correspondence. It is a history of writing economy rather than a new spoken word: readers normally recover hari from context, and formal prose can simply restore the full spelling.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 h 和 r 之间、后面的元音补回来：h-a-r-i。hr 是“天”的压缩写法，读的时候还原 hari。

senses.zh_definition: 灰尘；尘屑。散布于地面、附着于物体表面或随风飘浮的干燥细小颗粒。
senses.en_definition: Fine, dry particles that settle on surfaces or are carried through the air; dust.
senses.ms_definition: Butiran halus dan kering yang terdapat di atas tanah atau permukaan benda, atau berterbangan di udara.
senses.nuances: 通常作物质名词，不直接计数；可说 sedikit habuk（一点灰尘）或 lapisan habuk（一层灰尘）。habuk gergaji 专指锯木产生的木屑。berhabuk 的口语引申义属于派生词，不能直接移作 habuk 的独立义项。释义依据：[DBP PRPM：habuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=habuk)。

etymology.historical_story: Habuk belongs to the everyday vocabulary of surfaces, cleaning and airborne particles. Its dictionary compounds also connect it with woodworking: habuk gergaji means sawdust. This offers a concrete cultural association between household dust and workshop debris. The supplied evidence does not establish a donor language, an earliest attestation or a deeper historical derivation.

senses.zh_definition: 传统重量单位，等于一百分之一 tahil，或十分之一 ci。
senses.en_definition: A traditional unit of weight equal to one hundredth of a tahil or one tenth of a ci.
senses.ms_definition: Ukuran berat bersamaan satu perseratus tahil atau satu persepuluh ci.
senses.nuances: 多见于旧式度量衡资料。输入所载《Kamus Dewan》另列“6.48 gm”，但该数值与同一资料体系中的 tahil 换算存在冲突，不能直接作为可靠克数。此处保留相对单位关系，不擅自确定克数。搭配为释义性示例，不宣称具有高语料频率。参见 [PRPM：hun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=hun) 与 [PRPM：tahil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tahil)。

senses.zh_definition: 传统长度单位，词典记为八分之一英寸，约三点一毫米。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan marks hun as Chinese in origin. Its paired meanings preserve a world in which small quantities could be described through inherited weight and length systems rather than metric units. The available evidence does not establish a particular Chinese dialect, donor pronunciation, or borrowing date. [Source: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=hun).

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 初次或正式接触时可按身份称 Encik Henri、Dr. Henri 等；称谓须符合本人身份与偏好，姓名读音应尊重本人。

etymology.historical_story: If the token denotes the French given name Henri, its history belongs to European naming traditions. The Lyon municipal library traces it to Germanic elements associated with home and rulership. That history explains a possible personal name, but it does not establish the identity of this lowercase corpus token or a Malay common-word meaning. [Library explanation](https://www.guichetdusavoir.org/question/voir/137872).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若上下文是人名，把 Henri 整体对应“亨利”，并记住姓名首字母大写；具体读音以本人使用的读法为准。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root 沿用输入包的标记，不表示已证实其为马来语固有词根。作为人名时写作 Hess；不拆分 ss，也不据此推定长辅音。未核实标准读音。

senses.zh_definition: 赫斯：人名中的姓氏，作专有名词使用；此释义对应大写形式 Hess，不能据此认定小写 hess 是标准马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: Hess: a surname used as a proper noun; this interpretation does not establish lowercase hess as a standard Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Hess ialah nama keluarga yang digunakan sebagai kata nama khas bagi seseorang; penggunaan ini tidak mengesahkan hess sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 此处为根据实际人名用例编写的编辑释义，并非 DBP 对 hess 的官方释义。DBP 的 berkelok 词条例句出现 Tuan Hess，支持其作为人名的用法；下列搭配分别为已见用例和示范性称谓组合，不宣称具有高频统计依据。[DBP：berkelok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=berkelok)

etymology.historical_story: A name can appear in a dictionary without being the word that the dictionary defines. In DBP's entry for berkelok, Hess appears after the title Tuan in an example sentence. This supports interpreting that occurrence as a personal name, but it supplies no surname etymology and establishes no separate Malay meaning for lowercase hess. [DBP: berkelok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=berkelok)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Tuan Hess，就把 Hess 放进“姓氏”这一格：前面是称谓，后面是人名。本记忆提示不推定其读音或词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入中的 is_root=false 和 harmon 原样保留，但不能据此分析为 harmon + -i；现代马来语应将 harmoni 整词记忆。mengharmonikan 中 meN- 在 h 前取 meng-，h 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 声音或音乐协调悦耳的；各声部相互配合的。
senses.en_definition: Musically harmonious; having sounds or voices that blend well.
senses.ms_definition: Selaras dan serasi dari segi bunyi, nada atau suara.
senses.nuances: 形容声音之间的配合，不单指音量小或旋律好听；名词性的音乐术语另见义项四。[DBP：harmoni](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=harmoni)

senses.zh_definition: 人与人或群体之间关系和睦、相互尊重、和平相处的。
senses.en_definition: Peaceful and mutually agreeable in personal or social relationships.
senses.ms_definition: Rukun, mesra dan damai dalam hubungan antara individu atau kelompok.
senses.nuances: 常用于家庭、邻里及族群关系；强调相处融洽，不要求所有人观点相同。[DBP：harmoni](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=harmoni)

senses.zh_definition: 行动、意见、情感或视觉元素之间相互协调、配合的状态。
senses.en_definition: Agreement or compatibility among actions, opinions, feelings or visual elements.
senses.ms_definition: Persesuaian antara tindakan, pendapat, perasaan atau unsur yang digabungkan.
senses.nuances: 这里指协调关系本身；形容性用法如 warna yang harmoni 则表示色彩搭配协调。[DBP：harmoni](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=harmoni)

senses.zh_definition: 和声；音乐中同时发声的音及其组合、配置关系。
senses.en_definition: Harmony: the combination and arrangement of simultaneously sounding musical notes.
senses.ms_definition: Gabungan not yang dibunyikan serentak serta susunannya dalam muzik.
senses.nuances: 这是音乐术语；与按时间先后展开的 melodi（旋律）有所区别。[DBP：harmoni](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=harmoni)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Program kejiranan ini bertujuan membina masyarakat yang harmoni melalui kerjasama dan sikap saling menghormati.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这项邻里计划旨在通过合作与相互尊重，建设和谐社会。
dual_scenarios.en: This neighbourhood programme aims to build a harmonious community through cooperation and mutual respect.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Walaupun kita lain pendapat, kita boleh hidup harmoni je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Walaupun kita berbeza pendapat, kita masih boleh hidup harmoni.
dual_scenarios.zh: 就算意见不同，我们也一样可以好好相处啊。
dual_scenarios.en: Even if we disagree, we can still get along just fine.
spoken_features: lain pendapat 是 berbeza pendapat 的口语表达
je 在这里缓和语气，不必逐字译为 hanya
dah 对应 sudah
tak 对应 tidak

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (邻居)
messages.ms_spoken: Kita dah bincang elok-elok. Harap lepas ni semua boleh hidup harmoni lah.
messages.ms_standard: Kita sudah berbincang dengan baik. Saya berharap agar selepas ini semua orang dapat hidup harmoni.
messages.zh: 我们已经好好谈过了。希望以后大家都能和睦相处吧。
messages.en: We've talked it through properly. Hopefully everyone can get along from now on.

messages.speaker: Farah (邻居)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul. Tak semestinya kena setuju semua benda, janji saling hormat.
messages.ms_standard: Betul. Kita tidak semestinya perlu bersetuju dalam semua perkara, asalkan kita saling menghormati.
messages.zh: 对啊，也不用每件事都意见一致，互相尊重就行。
messages.en: Exactly. We don't have to agree on everything, as long as we respect each other.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合正式致辞、学校作文、职场交流和日常谈话。谈及族群或宗教关系时，搭配 saling menghormati（相互尊重）能让表达更具体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于赞美和睦关系、音乐及设计。处理争议时，应说明实际问题及解决办法，避免只用保持和谐来要求对方停止表达合理意见。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合正式致辞、学校作文、职场交流和日常谈话。谈及族群或宗教关系时，搭配 saling menghormati（相互尊重）能让表达更具体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于赞美和睦关系、音乐及设计。处理争议时，应说明实际问题及解决办法，避免只用保持和谐来要求对方停止表达合理意见。

etymology.historical_story: Malay harmoni carries both musical and social meanings: voices can blend, and neighbours can live peacefully together. The related English word harmony ultimately connects with Greek harmonia, associated with joining or fitting together. This offers a useful historical comparison, although it does not establish the immediate borrowing route into Malay. The shared image is distinct parts forming a workable whole. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=harmoni); [University of Iowa](https://bam.sites.uiowa.edu/its-greek-me/harmony)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 联想 harmony：合唱时声音合得来，邻里间人也合得来，都是 harmoni。

morphology.formula: ∅ + hayaat → hayaat（保留待核输入形式）
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包保留整词分析；不能把 aa 当作马来语词缀或据此确定长元音。若原意是“生命”，需核实是否应规范为 hayat；未核实前不建立派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 待核实的输入拼写，尚不能确认为独立的标准马来语名词；若原意为 hayat，则表示生命、性命或在世期间。
senses.en_definition: An unverified spelling, possibly intended as hayat, meaning life or the period of being alive.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk ejaan yang belum disahkan sebagai kata bahasa Melayu baku; jika yang dimaksudkan ialah hayat, maknanya kehidupan atau keadaan bernyawa.
senses.nuances: 输入包没有释义或语音依据，本次检索未找到支持 hayaat 为标准马来语词目的可靠证据。DBP 收录的是 hayat。词性仅按这一可能对应词暂列 noun；下面的搭配与例句讨论拼写本身，不冒充已确立的词义用例。status 因而标为 unverified。[DBP hayat 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=300728&keyword=hayat)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penyunting perlu menyemak bentuk 'hayaat' dalam manuskrip dan menentukan sama ada penulis bermaksud 'hayat'.
dual_scenarios.zh: 编辑需要核查手稿中的“hayaat”，确定作者是否原本想写“hayat”。
dual_scenarios.en: The editor must check the form 'hayaat' in the manuscript and establish whether the author intended 'hayat'.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Saya jumpa 'hayaat' kat sini. Maksudnya 'hayat' ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya menemukan bentuk 'hayaat' di sini. Adakah yang dimaksudkan ialah 'hayat'?
dual_scenarios.zh: 我在这里看到“hayaat”，是想写“hayat”吗？
dual_scenarios.en: I found 'hayaat' here. Is it supposed to be 'hayat'?
spoken_features: kat 对应标准语 di。
句末 ke 表示疑问，标准语可改用 Adakah…。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Saya dah baca draf tu. 'Hayaat' kat sini maksudnya 'hayat' ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca draf itu. Adakah bentuk 'hayaat' di sini dimaksudkan sebagai 'hayat'?
messages.zh: 我看过草稿了。这里的“hayaat”是想写“hayat”吗？
messages.en: I've read the draft. Is 'hayaat' here supposed to be 'hayat'?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Mungkin. Saya nak tanya penulis dulu, lepas tu baru betulkan.
messages.ms_standard: Mungkin. Saya hendak bertanya kepada penulis dahulu sebelum membetulkannya.
messages.zh: 可能吧。我想先问问作者，再修改。
messages.en: Possibly. I'll check with the author before changing it.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 纠正他人文字时，可说 Adakah yang dimaksudkan ialah hayat?，先确认本意，避免武断地改动姓名或外语转写。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 普通马来语中若意为“生命”，使用已确认的 hayat。若 Hayaat 是人名、机构名或原文转写，应尊重其正式拼写，并另行确认读音与所指。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 纠正他人文字时，可说 Adakah yang dimaksudkan ialah hayat?，先确认本意，避免武断地改动姓名或外语转写。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 普通马来语中若意为“生命”，使用已确认的 hayat。若 Hayaat 是人名、机构名或原文转写，应尊重其正式拼写，并另行确认读音与所指。

etymology.historical_story: No independent Malay etymology can be established for hayaat from the supplied evidence. The possible intended word, hayat, is identified by DBP as Arabic in origin and denotes life. Its Malay relatives include menghayati and penghayatan, associated with inward appreciation. This background applies to hayat; it does not authenticate hayaat as a standard spelling. [DBP dictionary entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=300728&keyword=hayat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若要表达“生命”，先核对标准词 hayat：ha-yat，两音节；不要把待核拼写 hayaat 当作另一种标准写法。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是连写的强调附着小品词，不是改变词类的派生后缀；suffix 在此仅表示其后附位置。hati 的音段不变。输入 Jawi 仅对应 hati，未包含 -lah。[DBP：强调小品词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel)

senses.zh_definition: 受到强调的“内心、心意或情感”；具体强调范围由句子决定。
senses.en_definition: The heart or inner feelings, with contextual emphasis from -lah.
senses.ms_definition: Batin atau tempat timbulnya perasaan dan keinginan, dengan penegasan oleh partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: hatilah 不是 hati-hati“当心”的缩写。在 suka hatilah 中，整个短语可表示“随你的便”，语气可能是许可、无奈或不耐烦。以下搭配兼列含目标形式的短语及词基 hati 的常用搭配。释义为组合释写。[DBP：hati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=hati)

senses.zh_definition: 肝脏；加 -lah 时突出肝脏是所谈论的器官。
senses.en_definition: The liver, emphasized as the organ under discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Organ yang menghasilkan hempedu dan menjalankan pelbagai fungsi metabolisme, dengan penegasan oleh -lah.
senses.nuances: 解剖学中的 hati 通常译为 liver；心脏通常称 jantung。hatilah 的强调作用须结合句式理解，如 Hatilah yang menghasilkan hempedu。搭配列出词基的常用组合。[DBP：hati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=hati)

senses.zh_definition: 植物、木材或果实的中心部分；加 -lah 时突出这一部位。
senses.en_definition: The central or inner part of wood or fruit, with contextual emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian tengah pada kayu, buah atau benda tertentu, dengan penegasan oleh -lah.
senses.nuances: 这是 hati 的中心部位义，并非所有物体的“中心”都可自由用 hati 表示。常见组合包括 hati kayu 和 hati nanas；-lah 只增加句中强调。[DBP：hati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=hati)

senses.zh_definition: 心、心脏，尤见于描写心跳或情绪反应的表达；-lah 增加强调。
senses.en_definition: The heart, especially in descriptions of heartbeat or emotional response, with added emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Jantung, khususnya dalam ungkapan yang menggambarkan debaran atau tindak balas perasaan, dengan penegasan oleh -lah.
senses.nuances: DBP 引述《Kamus Dewan Perdana》时也列出 hati 的 jantung 义，常见于 hatinya berdebar 等表达。具体医学说明宜使用 jantung，以明确器官所指。[DBP：hati 与 jantung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ada+hati)

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友商量出发时间
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Suka hatilah kalau nak pergi dulu. Aku tunggu sini je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Terpulang kepada kamu jika kamu mahu pergi dahulu. Saya akan menunggu di sini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你想先走就先走吧，我就在这里等。
dual_scenarios.en: Go ahead if you want to leave first. I'll just wait here.

nak 对应 mahu，je 对应 sahaja。
口语可省略 di sini 中的 di。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak pergi dulu, boleh? Dah lewat ni.
messages.ms_standard: Bolehkah saya pergi dahulu? Sekarang sudah lewat.
messages.zh: 我能先走吗？已经很晚了。
messages.en: Can I head off first? It's getting late.

messages.ms_spoken: Suka hatilah. Aku tunggu sini je sampai hujan reda.

etymology.historical_story: Malay hati connects bodily language with the inner life: the dictionary records the liver, feelings, and the central part of certain objects. Hatilah adds the emphatic particle -lah without creating a new lexical root. In conversation, a larger expression such as suka hatilah acquires its force from the relationship and tone. [DBP: hati](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=hati)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hati 记“肝、内心、中心”，lah 记“强调一下”；hatilah 的意思要放回整句话里判断。

etymology.historical_story: Himalaya comes ultimately from Sanskrit hima, meaning snow, and ālaya, meaning abode: an abode of snow. The name evokes the range's snowy heights. In Malay, it functions as a complete geographical proper name rather than a word assembled with Malay affixes. The Sanskrit explanation is documented in an [Indian government forestry report](https://hpforest.gov.in/storage/files/1/pdf/DPR/Ravi/1.%20Ravi%20-%20Volume-I.pdf).

senses.zh_definition: 真厉害；真出色；以强调语气称赞某人、表现或事物非同寻常。

senses.ms_definition: Luar biasa dari segi kebolehan, mutu, kegagahan atau keelokan, dengan penegasan oleh partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 通常用于赞叹；讽刺语调也可使其变成反话。整个形式仍以形容词 hebat 为核心，不能仅因带 -lah 就把整个词归为 particle。基础词义见 [DBP PRPM：hebat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=hebat)；附着语气成分见 [DBP：kata penegas](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)。

senses.zh_definition: 强烈得惊人；猛烈或激烈得非同寻常，带强调语气。

senses.ms_definition: Teramat kuat, dahsyat atau sengit, dengan penegasan oleh partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: hebat 不只表示「优秀」，也可描写爆炸、争吵或战斗的强度。以下为基式 hebat 的常见搭配；是否附加 -lah 取决于句式和强调需要。

senses.zh_definition: 【古典文学义】感到害怕、敬畏或畏惧，带强调语气。
senses.en_definition: In classical literary usage, afraid, overawed, or intimidated, with emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan sastera lama, berasa takut atau segan, dengan penegasan oleh partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 此义继承自 hebat 的古典文学用法，现代日常交流中不常见。以下搭配用于说明古典义的结构，不应当作现代高频表达；现代通常改用 takut、gerun 或 segan。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves a striking contrast within hebat: modern speakers use it for impressive excellence or overwhelming intensity, while classical literature also records fear and awe. This contrast helps explain its expressive range without assuming every occurrence is praise. The attached -lah adds emphasis, giving the familiar exclamation hebatlah its conversational force. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=hebat).
